derivation:
1808. Compose the original physical pivot reconstruction, measure and shell localization in one fixed free-coordinate system. Evaluate this exact local identity, not a new generic norm lemma or a claim of uniform physical admission.

FIXED DATA AND TYPES. Use the source original first-step Omega1=X, independent fine set A=E_fine(X), raw exterior F_src, active independent coarse rows I and J from the closed1806 binding. Set n=|A|, m=|I|, r=real dim(g), and S=A minus beta(I), p=n-m. Here p is a coordinate count, NOT the exponent p_cut in the fixed LAW1559 cutoff. The source first lattice is unit scale; retain other scale conventions through their explicit coordinate isometries if used. Each inverse orientation is dependent. Keep the SAME G, real Lie metric/basis, physical mean M (one choice only), V0,V, background U1 with M_I(U1)=V_I, gauge factors, original supports, beta_ref and fixed C_delta/p_cut. All V/history-dependent coefficients below are held fixed when differentiating fluctuation variables. No target-variable elimination is used.

LINEAR/NONLINEAR MAPS IN REAL LIE COORDINATES. In the source's real Hermitian coordinates write
 F(a)=(1/i)Log[M_I(exp(i a)U1) V_I^-1], P=DF(0).
All logs, group-valuedness and domains are those actually admitted by the source; the assertion is not a global definition at arbitrary fields. The unitary/anti-Hermitian velocity convention of1759 is identified by multiplication by i, an isometry on the declared real basis. Let P_beta be the selected m*r by m*r block, assumed invertible on the original admitted source reference chart, and h supported on beta with P h=Id. This is the ORIGINAL selected block, not an arbitrary minor. In the normalized coarse-potential convention Q=P/L, the same condition is LQh=Id. P is the UNDIVIDED coarse group-log derivative; this distinction fixes all later L factors.

Let D be the actual source nonlinear solution, D(0)=0, Dprime(0)=0, and
 N(B)=B-hD(B), F(N(B))=P B.
These are the source local straightening equations with the chosen mean, not the older relative mean substituted for it. Let C be the original linear lift satisfying P C=0 and (C a)_S=a. In block notation (C a)_beta=-P_beta^-1 P_S a. The pre-shell original field is U(a)=exp(i N(g0 C a))U1 on A, with U=V0 on F_src. On free links, N(g0 C a)_S=g0 a exactly. Selected outputs are not new integration coordinates.

SHELL LOCALIZATION IS A FURTHER MAP ON FREE COORDINATES. CMP119(1.20)-(1.24) changes free links b in S1star before the conditional integral(1.26). Call the whole map R: new a -> pre-shell a. On the first class in(1.22),
 R_b(a_b)=(1/(i g0))Log[exp(i g0 a_b) exp(-i gamma_b(a_b) H_b)],
where gamma_b is the original C-infinity guard called g in the source. On the second class gamma_b=1; off S1star, R_b=a_b. The original H_b is fixed by the two actual background configurations through(1.21), not a fluctuation variable. Do not replace that H by the sparse h or Hsharp. The map is blockwise on the original free bonds; its Jacobian is J_R=product_b |det DR_b| on an admitted real diffeomorphism branch. No global complex-analytic extension of the smooth guard is claimed.

The source first builds Lambda1 inside the twice-eroded Omega1 and outside the enlarged R1prime, while S1 is the outer layer plus R1. The buffered original construction, and its later shrinking of Lambda1, keep S1star disjoint from the conditional inner free set S_in=S intersect E_fine(Lambda1). Consequently R_in(a)=a_in. The complete physical reconstruction AFTER shell localization is
 B=g0 C R(a), a_phys=N(B), U_A(a)=exp(i a_phys) U1_A, U_F=V0.
It is not obtained by replacing every output by exp(i g0 C a) times a localized background. Even where a free shell link has gamma=1 and exp(i g0 R_b(a_b))U1_b=exp(i g0 a_b)U1_local,b, a selected output must still be reconstructed by the full C and N about the ORIGINAL U1. This matters for complete crossing/rooted words.

FIXED K_C. Let S_out=S minus S_in, and keep a_out fixed in the conditional integral. The unchanged law is K_C(g0)=product_(b in S_in){||a_b||_*<C_delta ell^p_cut}, ell=log(g0^-2), in its original declared norm/basis. Because R_in is the identity, R^-1(K_C times whole exterior)=K_C times whole exterior on its actual map domain; no radius is resized. This does NOT identify every other original characteristic function with that one product or repair the printed A1/A0 prefactor discrepancy. Keep all other original characteristic functions as composed factors in the density, and keep exactly the fixed version1535/1559. It also does not prove that N/C/R and the chosen mean branches exist and are one-to-one on the WHOLE original K_C for every admissible history. That uniform reconstruction/domain gate remains explicitly open. One admitted chart contribution may not be renamed the full Z_C; its original complementary contribution is retained.

MEASURE COMPOSITION WITH ORIGINAL NORMALIZATION. Let sigma(a) be density of normalized group Haar in the real coordinates U=exp(i a), sigma0=sigma(0)>0, s(a)=sigma(a)/sigma0. On the same strict identity chart, delta_G(exp(i x))=sigma0^-1 delta_g(x). Work on an orientation-consistent admitted local diffeomorphism branch; otherwise use absolute determinants and actual branch multiplicity/support, not an unproved Trlog. The original active-fine integral with the active group deltas, all original weight Phi(U,V), and a free-domain restriction pulled back from the SAME free coordinates has density in final a:

 (g0^r sigma0)^p * |det P_beta|^-1
 * [product_(b in A) s(a_phys,b)] * |det DN(B)| * J_R(a)
 * Phi(U(a),V) da.

The retained exterior delta on J, prescribed V0, source sector sum and every original gauge/normalization factor remain outside or inside Phi in their ORIGINAL locations. In particular no axial gauge bonds are removed merely because an older construction had axial delta gauge fixing: CMP119 uses its actual exponential gauge weight. The count p=n-m is fine bonds minus coarse-row pivots. The printed gauge-normalizer exponent comes instead from the source gauge-site integrations; its coarse-site count must not silently be replaced by m, which counts coarse BONDS. Do not set its z to1 or combine those unlike counts. This input leaves that gauge factor unchanged and does not numerically reevaluate it.

DERIVATION OF THE FACTOR. Right translation by U1 has Haar factor1. Exponential coordinates on n fine links supply sigma0^n product s. Conversion of m group deltas at the matched target supplies sigma0^-m. The nonlinear substitution a_phys=N(B) supplies |det DN(B)| and straightens F to P B. Scaling B=g0 y gives g0^(nr) from Lebesgue and g0^(-mr) from delta(P g0 y). Solving P y=0 in the ORIGINAL pivot coordinates gives y=C a_pre and |det P_beta|^-1, with da_pre the coordinate-projection measure on the remaining free links. No sqrt(det(C^T C)) is inserted: this is delta elimination in independent original coordinates, not an induced surface-volume declaration. Finally a_pre=R(a) supplies J_R. If the source linear map is written Q=P/L, the identical selected factor is L^(-mr)|det Q_beta|^-1. In particular, at a flat calibration P_beta=L^(1-d)Id, it is L^((d-1)mr), not L^(dmr). This is a convention check, not the original nonflat uniform bound. The source z^(0) is the selected linear-delta elimination factor in the source's actual normalization; identify it with this expression only after matching whether that displayed linear map is P or Q, rather than assuming its normalization from notation.

EXACT RECONCILIATION WITH RAW-GROUP ELIMINATION. On the constraint F(N(B))=0, differentiation in B_beta, with all other B fixed, gives
 Fprime_beta(a_phys) DN_beta,beta(B)=P_beta.
Because N is the identity on the free rows, det DN=det DN_beta,beta. Therefore
 |det DN(B)|/|det P_beta|=1/|det Fprime_beta(a_phys)|.
The physical mean depends diagonally on the selected original pivots; in the unitary velocity convention, with real Lie identification by i,
 Fprime_beta=diag_c[A_c(U(a)) dexp_(i a_phys,beta(c))].
At the constraint, the target-relative Log differential is identity; no extra target-dependent transport determinant remains. On the strict exponential chart s(a)=|det dexp_(i a)|. The pivot s factors therefore cancel the pivot exponential differentials, yielding the EQUIVALENT density

 g0^(p*r) * [product_(b in S) sigma(g0 R_b(a_b))]
 * J_R(a) * product_(c in I)|det A_c(U(a))|^-1
 * Phi(U(a),V) da.

These are alternative representations of ONE factor. Never multiply the raw-group product |det A_c|^-1 by the previous expression that already contains det DN/P_beta and all pivot Haar densities. This equality uses the actual real solution and original basis. It does not prove uniform invertibility on K_C, branch coverage, or nonzero denominator. Source v(g0 C a_pre) already groups the logarithms of the transformed Haar density and nonlinear Jacobian; those logs are not a license to insert the same sigma/determinant again. Keep the nonlinear argument a_phys=N(g0 C R(a)) throughout.

CONDITIONAL EXTERIOR AND MARKS. At fixed source history, V and a_out, the shell Jacobian J_R and free outer Haar factors depend only on a_out and those parameters, so they are outside the inner integral. They cancel from an inner normalized expectation ONLY if the identical nonzero inner denominator is used. They still belong to the OUTER/history measure and its variation. The raw selected factor A_c(U(a)) generally depends on a_in; it is not such a constant. The alternative reference factor P_beta(U1) is fixed at the given background, but its V dependence belongs to the full first normalizer, as does the source z^(0)(V) in LAW1535. No vacuum ratio cancels it without proof.

Insert each COMPLETE original rooted/open word as W(U(a),V0,V), including every selected reconstructed link, inverse, root and both endpoint frames. Interior, crossing and purely raw-exterior words use the same map. A word supported entirely on F_src retains its ordered prescribed V0 value; a word merely rooted outside need not have that support. Finite complex sources exp(sum tr[J_alpha W_alpha]) are evaluated on this same real reconstruction and same K_C. Where the original unmarked graph/branch weight is absolutely integrable and the words bounded on the real unitary data, coefficient/source derivatives are justified by domination on compact J sets; this is not differentiation in a moving V domain or a uniform connected estimate. No normalized log or cumulant is asserted without a proved nonzero full denominator. A free-shell link formula with localized U1 is insufficient for a crossing word that also uses a selected output.

DISPOSITION REQUESTED. Decide the exact validity of this complete symbolic LOCAL composition, its source shell/index interpretation, fixed-K_C invariance on its admitted domain and the determinant cancellation; preserve any corrections as adverse evidence. Do not turn the remaining uniform N/C/R/branch admission, threshold ratio, original characteristic functions or marked-integral equality over every K_C/history into assumed results. Source190/Hsharp, P1, physical localization, simultaneous absorptions/common parameters, actual beta_ref/g1_ref amplitude matching, offchart, outer normalizer, connected sum and history remain open. No new paper, grade, review of the whole manuscript or physical admission. The next actual falsifier is an admitted source configuration where the proposed normalization/count or shell-inner separation fails; another generic covariance lemma cannot settle it.
